text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-who did this?! Who put this<n>banana peel here?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, didn't I set up a<n>prank around
here not long ago?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! Nooo! This is the biggest<n>screwup of my
life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After falling for her own prank, Shinko<n>Windy
becomes rather dejected.
